result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation bar where missing safe-area padding causes the system home indicator to overlap the navigation icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks sufficient bottom safe-area padding, causing the system home indicator bar to overlap directly across the search and orders/receipt icons.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding to the bottom navigation bar container so that the navigation icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
